7	+## Context
8	+
9	+All references are to `release/v0.127.3`. The full evidence is in the research note kept with the run.
10	+
11	+Today, an invited person takes this path:
12	+
13	+1. The email link is `<web_url>/auth?token&email&organization_id&workspace_id&project_id` (`organization_service.py:139-145`). The invite lasts 7 days (`:202`).
14	+2. `isDesktopOnlyLink` holds the link on the old app for every kind of user (`mobileGate/index.ts:343`).
15	+3. The old sign-in sends a new person to `/workspaces/accept?survey=true` and an existing person to `/workspaces/accept` (`web/oss/src/hooks/usePostAuthRedirect.ts:129-157`).
16	+4. The old accept page posts to the accept endpoint through `acceptWorkspaceInvite` (`web/packages/agenta-entities/src/organization/workspaceApi.ts:122-154`). On the cloud edition a new person then sees the `/post-signup` form, which sends `survey sent` (`web/ee/src/components/PostSignupForm/PostSignupForm.tsx:245`).
17	+
18	+On `/m` today:
19	+
20	+- `useSignInFlow` offers an `onInvite` callback for exactly this purpose (`web/packages/agenta-auth-ui/src/useSignInFlow.ts:157-163`), and `SignInScreen.tsx:49-56` does not pass it.
21	+- `useAuthSuccess` always goes to `/`, and a signed-in visit to `/auth` also goes to `/` (`features/app/authRoute.ts:19-27`).
22	+- `/` is `ContextResolver`, which forwards to a project home. It shows "No projects found." when the person has no project (`ContextResolver.tsx:98-103`).
23	+- A new account gets a pending onboarding mark. Home dismisses the mark when the project has agents, and otherwise starts the full flow (`onboardingPending.ts:70-82`).
24	+- The website `?template=` value already survives sign-in through localStorage with a 30 minute window (`lib/context.ts:29-70`).
25	+
26	+Password reset links are `<web_url>/auth/reset-password?token=...&tenantId=public` (`api/oss/src/core/auth/supertokens/config.py:70-73`). They carry `token` and never `organization_id`. `/m` has no reset screen.
27	+
28	+## Goals / Non-Goals
29	+
30	+Goals:
31	+
32	+- A new person and an existing person both join through `/m` from the emailed link, with every sign-in method.
33	+- A signed-in person with a different email sees the old page's mismatch message and can switch account.
34	+- An invite link already in an inbox keeps working.
35	+
36	+Non-goals:
37	+
38	+- Removing the old `/workspaces/accept` page. Nothing emails that URL (`organization_service.py` is the only link producer).
39	+- Fixing the API text and check order listed as side bugs in the research note.
40	+
41	+## Decisions
42	+
43	+### Where the accept screen lives
44	+
45	+| Option | Trade-off |
46	+| --- | --- |
47	+| **`/m/invite`** | Outside `/auth`, so `authRedirectTarget` leaves a signed-in person there. |
48	+| `/m/auth/accept` | `isAuthRoute` would send a signed-in person to `/`, and `authRoute.ts` would need an exception. |
49	+| `/m/workspaces/accept` | Same path as the old page, but workspaces are being removed. |
50	+
51	+### How the invite survives sign-in
52	+
53	+| Option | Trade-off |
54	+| --- | --- |
55	+| **localStorage with a 30 minute window, written through `onInvite`** | The same shape as `?template=`. It survives a provider redirect. The token is removed on every final outcome. |
56	+| Carry the values in the OAuth state | It needs changes to the SuperTokens call and does nothing for password sign-in. |
57	+| A cookie | Sent to the server on every request, which a one-time token does not need. |
58	+
59	+A person who takes longer than 30 minutes opens the link again, because the link lasts 7 days.
60	+
61	+### Who sends the person to the accept screen
62	+
63	+| Option | Trade-off |
64	+| --- | --- |
65	+| **`ContextResolver`, before it resolves a project** | All sign-in paths and the signed-in visit end at `/`, so there is one reader. It also covers a person with no project yet. |
66	+| `useAuthSuccess` plus `OidcCallbackScreen` plus `authRoute` | Three places to keep in step. |
67	+
68	+### What the desktop gate tests
69	+
70	+| Option | Trade-off |
71	+| --- | --- |
72	+| **An invite link is an `/auth` link with both `token` and `organization_id`** | Reset links have no `organization_id`, so they keep today's route. |
73	+| Any `/auth?token=` | It would move reset links to `/m`, which has no reset screen. |
74	+
75	+The forward runs before the opt-out and Classic mode checks, and it keeps the query. `decideMobileGate` lets `/invite` and an invite link on `/auth` pass, because `desktopRouteFor` would drop the token.
76	+
77	+### Onboarding for a new invited person (Mahmoud chose questions only)
78	+
79	+| Option | Trade-off |
80	+| --- | --- |
81	+| **Questions only, then the invited project** | Keeps today's survey event. Needs a small path in onboarding. |
82	+| No questions | The least work. PostHog loses these answers. |
83	+| Leave `/m` as it is | No work. A viewer in an empty project gets steps written for an owner. |
84	+
85	+The accept screen adds an invited mark next to the pending mark and opens onboarding directly, so Home does not change. The onboarding host then shows only the question steps, sends the same events, ends onboarding after the last question, and opens the project home. It also skips seeding tool connections, because that belongs to setting up a new organization.
86	+
87	+### Invite link when email is off
88	+
89	+The API returns `{url}` when no email service is set up (`organization_service.py:295`), and `MembersTab.tsx` discarded it. `/m` now shows it in `InvitedLinkDialog`. Resending an invite stays out of scope, because `/m` has no resend action yet.
90	+
91	+### Wording
92	+
93	+Every string comes from the old page, so nothing is invented. `/m` cannot import `web/oss`, so the strings are copied into `features/invite/`.
94	+
95	+## Risks / Trade-offs
96	+
97	+- A token sits in localStorage for up to 30 minutes. The old app also stores it there, with no window.
98	+- A shared browser: a second person who signs in within the window reaches the accept screen, and the API answers with the mismatch code. They see the error card, and "Go back to your workspaces" clears the invite.
99	+- A Helm install with the old web app turned off has no page for an old `/auth` link (`hosting/kubernetes/helm/tests/test_web_mobile.py:157`). The API change fixes new links, and old links expire within 7 days.
100	+- A Classic mode person who reloads `/m/` while the invite is pending goes to the old app. The next visit to the link finishes it.
101	+
102	+## Migration
103	+
104	+No data migration. Deploy order does not matter, because the old app forwards old links and the old app still exists for anything already in progress. Rollback restores the old link path, and any `/m/auth` invite link sent in the meantime still signs in, but it does not accept until the person opens a new invite.

111	+## Why
112	+
113	+Invite emails open the old app. `api/oss/src/services/organization_service.py:139-145` builds `<web_url>/auth?token=...`, `isTokenBearingAuthLink` keeps that link on the old sign-in, and the person accepts on the old `/workspaces/accept` page. `/m` is the main app, and it drops every invite value except `email` during sign-in.
114	+
115	+## What Changes
116	+
117	+- The API builds the invite link with `/m/auth`.
118	+- The `/m` sign-in keeps the invite in browser storage through password, one-time code, social and SSO sign-in.
119	+- `/m` gets an accept screen at `/m/invite`, with the outcomes of the old page.
120	+- The person lands in the invited project.
121	+- A new invited person answers the onboarding questions only, then opens the invited project.
122	+- The desktop gate forwards an old invite link to `/m/auth` with its query. Password reset links stay where they are.
123	+- The mobile gate does not send an invite away from `/m` for a Classic mode user.
124	+- `/m` Members settings shows the invite link when the deployment has no email service.
125	+
126	+## Capabilities
127	+
128	+### New Capabilities
129	+
130	+- `mobile-invites`: joining an organization from an emailed invite link in `/m`.
131	+
132	+### Modified Capabilities
133	+
134	+None. No existing spec covers invites.
135	+

138	+- `api/oss/src/services/organization_service.py`: link path only. No API contract change.

141	+- `docs/design/onboarding-revamp/questions-and-survey-parity.md`: the old form no longer sends `survey sent` for invites.
142	+- No change to `web/oss` or `web/ee`, which are abandoned.

import {registerDriveMarkdown} from "@agenta/entity-ui/drive"
import {DEFAULT_PAGE_TITLE} from "@agenta/shared/utils"
import AppMessageContext from "@agenta/ui/app-message"
import {useVisualViewportHeight} from "@agenta/ui/hooks"
import type {AppProps} from "next/app"
import Head from "next/head"

import {AppProviders} from "@/features/app/AppProviders"
import {BareProviders} from "@/features/app/BareProviders"
import {GlobalDrawers} from "@/features/app/GlobalDrawers"
import {TabRunFavicon} from "@/features/app/TabRunFavicon"
import {DriveMarkdownRenderer} from "@/features/chat/DriveMarkdownRenderer"
import {isEmbedPath} from "@/features/embed/embedRoute"
import {MaintenanceNoticeBar} from "@/features/maintenance/MaintenanceNoticeBar"

// Side effect: binds projectIdAtom from the URL before React renders. See the module.
import "@/lib/seedProjectContext"

import "@/styles/globals.css"

// The drive's rendered markdown (quick look, previews) uses the chat's renderer — by injection,
// so the package never depends on a host's markdown stack.
registerDriveMarkdown(DriveMarkdownRenderer)

// Deliberately minimal: no provider fleet (the desktop _app's ~10 providers
// are the reason this app exists as a separate bundle). AppProviders holds
// only what the data layer needs: query client + jotai default store + SDK
// host pin + route→project sync.
export default function App({Component, pageProps, router}: AppProps) {
    // iOS Safari ignores `interactive-widget`, so on that browser the keyboard still opens over the
    // page and every `dvh` frame keeps its full height. This publishes the visible height as
    // `--ag-viewport-height`, which ScreenScaffold, AppShell and SessionWorkspace read with a
    // `100dvh` fallback. One mount here covers every screen. Idle when no keyboard is open.
    useVisualViewportHeight()

    // The embed widget runs inside other websites without an Agenta login: the data layer only.
    if (isEmbedPath(router.pathname)) {
        return (
            <BareProviders>
                <Component {...pageProps} />
            </BareProviders>
        )
    }

    return (
        <>
            <Head>
                {/* `interactive-widget=resizes-content` makes the on-screen keyboard shrink
                    the LAYOUT viewport, so every `dvh` frame below stops hiding its bottom edge —
                    the composer — behind the keyboard. Chrome and Android honour it. iOS Safari
                    ignores it, and `useVisualViewportHeight` below covers that half.
                    `viewport-fit=cover` stays: this app draws real safe-area insets. */}
                <meta
                    name="viewport"
                    content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover, interactive-widget=resizes-content"
                />
                {/* App-wide default: a route that names no title shows this, not the URL. */}
                <title>{DEFAULT_PAGE_TITLE}</title>
            </Head>
            <AppProviders>
                {/* In the page flow above every screen; screens shorten by its height. */}
                <MaintenanceNoticeBar />
                <Component {...pageProps} />
                {/* The imperative message/modal outlet the SHARED session verbs render their
                    confirms into (rename, delete). Antd-free — it is the kit's own
                    reimplementation of that API, not antd's App context. */}
                <AppMessageContext />
                <GlobalDrawers />
                <TabRunFavicon />
            </AppProviders>
        </>
    )
}

# Slop review

Base: 4a0eae2ea358038dc2d78818bc6dffdc946cfef0
Head: 9acd9c670dea38c1cffd8ca6d131835359da4562

## Findings

### 1. An expired or invalid invite stays in storage and keeps taking over the root
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/mobile/src/features/invite/useInviteAccept.ts:80, web/mobile/src/features/invite/useInviteAccept.ts:103, openspec/changes/invites-on-mobile/design.md:49
- What is wrong: The design says "The token is removed on every final outcome." The code removes it only after success, after already accepted, and on "Go back to your workspaces". `INVITE_EXPIRED` and `INVITE_NOT_FOUND` are final, because `inviteFailure` marks them not retryable, but `setFailure(outcome)` keeps the invite. To reach it, open an expired link and close the tab on the error card. For up to 30 minutes, each visit to `/m/` then goes to `/invite`, posts the dead token again, and shows the same card instead of the app. "Sign in with a different account" also keeps the dead invite, so the new account gets the same card after sign-in. Keeping the invite is correct only for `INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH` and for retryable failures.
- Smallest fix: Call `forgetInvite()` in the failure branch when the code is `INVITE_EXPIRED` or `INVITE_NOT_FOUND`. A `keepInvite` field on `InviteFailure` is enough to carry this. Otherwise, correct the sentence in the design.

### 2. The questions-only path brings back the answers that `endOnboarding` just deleted
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/mobile/src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlow.tsx:158, web/mobile/src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlowHost.tsx:189, web/mobile/src/features/onboarding/useDraftSave.ts
- What is wrong: On the last question, `reportCompleted` dispatches `completed`, and `onQuestionsDone` then calls `endOnboarding`, which clears the draft at once. The dispatch still re-renders, so the effect in `useDraftSave` queues the new draft. The timer or the flush on unmount then writes it back. Each new invited person who finishes the questions therefore keeps their answers in localStorage, although the `endOnboarding` comment says "its mark and answers go". The other exits do not have this problem, because no dispatch comes directly before the clear. The tests cannot catch it, because the host test mocks both `OnboardingFlow` and `endOnboarding`, and the flow test mocks `onQuestionsDone`. The stale draft is visible only if that person opens the onboarding page later, as a preview, so the harm is small.
- Smallest fix: Stop the draft save before the flow ends. For example, return a `stop` from `useDraftSave` that blocks later saves, and call it in the terminal branch of `advance`. Add one test with the real draft hook.

### 3. A person who only answers questions can be blocked by a failure to set up an agent
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/mobile/src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlowScreen.tsx:24, web/mobile/src/features/onboarding/OnboardingFlowHost.tsx:71
- What is wrong: The invited flow never creates an agent, and the change turns off tool seeding for it for that reason. But `OnboardingFlowScreen` still calls `useEphemeralAgent(true)`, and `OnboardingFlowHost` still runs `useOnboardingModel`, the templates query and the connections query. If the mint fails, the invited person sees "Couldn't set up your agent" through `OnboardingFlowError` in place of the three questions, and gets no way to the project except the retry on that error. The mint comment says this happens when the user has not hydrated within its timeout. The new path therefore depends on work that it does not use.
- Smallest fix: In `OnboardingFlowScreen`, read the invited mark once the profile loads, and pass `false` to `useEphemeralAgent` for an invited account. At the least, do not render `OnboardingFlowError` for that account.

### 4. The design says every string comes from the old page, but "Try again" does not
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/mobile/src/features/invite/states/InviteAcceptError.tsx:26, openspec/changes/invites-on-mobile/design.md:87
- What is wrong: The settled rule is that the strings are copied from the old page to avoid invented copy, and the design states "Every string comes from the old page, so nothing is invented." `web/oss/src/pages/workspaces/accept.tsx` has no retry control and no "Try again" text. The retry itself is useful and the spec asks for it. The problem is that the document makes a claim that is false, so a reader does not know that this label and behavior are new.
- Smallest fix: Change the sentence in the design to say that the retry button is the one addition to the old page.

### 5. Comments on the gate still say that invite links stay on desktop
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/packages/agenta-shared/src/utils/mobileGate/index.ts:121, web/packages/agenta-shared/tests/unit/mobileGate.test.ts:46, web/packages/agenta-shared/tests/unit/mobileGate.test.ts:403
- What is wrong: This change makes `isTokenBearingAuthLink` and `isDesktopOnlyLink` return false for an invite link. The `isDesktopOnlyLink` comment still lists "any `/auth` link carrying a one-time token" as a route that finishes where it landed. Two test comments still say "SuperTokens password-reset and invite links carry a one-time ?token=" under the title "leaves a token-bearing auth link on desktop". A reader of this file gets the opposite of the new rule.
- Smallest fix: Add "other than an invite link" to the `isDesktopOnlyLink` comment, and remove "and invite" from the two test comments.

### 6. The committed design points to a research note that is not in the repo
- Severity: Low
- Where: openspec/changes/invites-on-mobile/design.md:3, openspec/changes/invites-on-mobile/design.md:33
- What is wrong: The design says "The full evidence is in the research note kept with the run", and it scopes out "side bugs in the research note". The change does not include that note, so a later reader cannot find the evidence or learn what those side bugs are.
- Smallest fix: Name the side bugs in the non-goals list, and delete the reference to the note.

### 7. Nothing tests that Members opens the link dialog
- Severity: Low
- Where: web/mobile/src/features/settings/MembersTab.tsx:92, web/mobile/tests/unit/invitedLinkDialog.render.test.tsx
- What is wrong: The new tests render `InvitedLinkDialog` with its props only. The spec's two scenarios, a `{url}` response opens the dialog and a response without a link does not, live in the `onSuccess` branch of `MembersTab`, and no test runs that branch. If the branch breaks, the deployment with no email service silently loses its only way to share an invite, and the dialog tests still pass.
- Smallest fix: Add one `MembersTab` render test with a mocked `inviteToWorkspace` that resolves to `{url}` and then to `true`.

## Rationale

The main implementation is sound and follows the repo. I traced these paths and found no break in them: the password, one-time code and provider sign-in paths through `ContextResolver`, the signed-in visit to `/m/auth`, the gate order, and the question-only filter on `steps`. It reuses `onInvite`, `acceptWorkspaceInvite`, the pending-template storage shape and the projects query. Its tests assert real outcomes, including the StrictMode single accept and the Classic mode gates. No settled decision needs to be reopened. The live QA task, 7.2 in tasks.md, is still open, and I did not run the code.

The two strongest reasons that the rating is not zero are both small state problems on new paths. A dead invite stays in storage and redirects the root for up to 30 minutes, which contradicts the design (finding 1). The questions-only exit writes the onboarding draft back after it was cleared, and it can also be blocked by a draft agent mint that it never uses (findings 2 and 3). Each of these needs a small fix and none weakens the core design.

Rating: Low
